name: Making Repairs
label: Quest
description: Making Repairs: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This far from the Undercity, logistics are challenging and we have a dire shortage of building materials needed to help restore this fortress. I'd like your help with that.

The ruined village of Shadowvale can be found in the Whispering Forest, just southwest of here. One of the buildings has an old root cellar used to store all sorts of things. There are likely to be usable materials down there. Scavenge what you can and return to us.

clips.title: Progress
paras: They say location is everything. While this fortress may look imposing perched upon these bluffs, it's turning out to be quite the challenge to stay supplied this far from proper civilization. An unfortunate oversight on our part.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I'm glad to see that your trip to Shadowvale bore fruit. I'll send Breton and a few of the other new recruits over later to clear the rest of the cellar out and retrieve anything left down in the dark.

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
